detector: cusum_total (z_total vs the speaker's own EWMA reference)

status_rules.episode: alert within [start, end + 90 d] of an episode where the smoothed position (score − form) moves by > 8 pts within 180 d
status_rules.b6_literal: smoothed position (score − era − form) moves by > 8 pts within 180 d after the start of the CUSUM episode

sensitivity.note: in-sample, episodes of > 8 pts in ≤ 180 d; a Wilson CI on ~18 episodes is ± 20 points
